jobs.title: User Data Guidelines
jobs.description: User Data Guidelines | Substrata | Help Center Skip to main content All Collections Privacy User Data Guidelines User Data Guidelines How do we handle your data? Written by Ori Manor Zuckerman October 13, 2022 Is Substrata safe, secure, and private? Yes, it is. Your data is kept private, safe and secure at all times. Substrata adheres to the highest industry standards in these areas. What data does Substrata collect? Substrata prioritizes the confidentiality of our users' information. We only collect the data we are given permission to use by our customers, based on the features they choose to implement such as email data for 'Substrata Q for Email', or name and image from the users' Google account. Please read Substrata’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Use page to learn more about our user-oriented approach to privacy and security. What does Substrata do with my data? We collect data in a secure manner. All data sent to the server is anonymized. Any PII (Personal Information Indicator) stored by the user can only be accessed by the user or the organization’s owner and admins it belongs to. PIIs are kept to a bare minimum and only include name, email, and phone number, if possible. We do not share these details with anyone outside the user’s organization and we do not send any PIIs to any 3rd party service. Emails that the user chooses to analyze are sent to the server and are saved in an anonymized fashion. A user can request to delete all the data that Substrata holds in its servers. Deletion of any user data will take between 7-10 business days. Substrata Q's information use and transfer to any other app received from Google APIs will adhere to Google API Services User Data Policy , including the Limited Use requirements.
